ai_summary.key_headline: Spain's direct evolution faces Saudi counter after opening draws

spain: Lamine Yamal (not at best after injury - Doubtful)
Nico Williams (not at best after injury - Doubtful)

tactical_insights: Spain's Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams will test Saudi Arabia's compact wide defense and potential five-man backline.
Spain must improve finishing after their surprising goalless draw against Cape Verde in the opening match.
Luis de la Fuente's vertical 4-3-3 will challenge Georgios Donis's compact 4-4-2 and quick counter-attacking strategy.
